verdict.rationale: n8n's own materials say it lets users build multi-step agents inside workflows using their own models and tools. They also say agent reasoning is traceable on the canvas, that it connects to OpenAI, Anthropic, Google or open-source models with switchable providers, and that it ships an MCP Client node and Ollama/Groq credentials. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on configuring tools for an agent step (only page titles such as 'What agents do' and 'MCP Client' appear), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent and LLM steps.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can add AI agent or LLM steps inside a workflow, with model choice and tool use

citations.quote: Build and operationalize AI workflows and multi-step agents using your own data, models, and tools
Connect to OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or open-source models and switch providers without changing your architecture
Every step of your agents' reasoning, traceable on the canvas.
Leverage these models to build AI-powered workflows.
